name: The Forest Cafe
why_it_matters: Independent roadside cafe opposite the trek-point gate, near Club Mahindra. Ranked #1 of 8 restaurants on TripAdvisor in Kanatal — locals and trekkers come for fresh, homemade-style Garhwali food at a fraction of resort prices. Has a few rooms upstairs.
insider_tip: Ask for the Garhwali thali off-menu — they cook it on demand with mandua roti and gahat dal when ingredients are in stock. Don't expect the South Indian section unless you call ahead.
signature_address: Opposite Trek Point Gate, Chamba-Mussoorie Road, Kanatal 249145

name: Cafe Romano
why_it_matters: An anomaly at 8,500 ft — proper wood-fired Italian pizza with a Himalayan view, attached to The Terraces resort but open to non-residents. Ranked #3 in Kanatal on TripAdvisor with a 4.8 rating. The only place in Kanatal that serves alcohol on a printed menu.
insider_tip: Outdoor seating faces snow-capped peaks on clear days — go for a late lunch (1-2pm) when the light is best. Pepperoni and mushroom hold up better than the Hawaiian.
signature_address: The Terraces Resort, Chamba-Mussoorie Highway, Kanatal 249145

name: Club Mahindra Kanatal Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: The largest resort kitchen in Kanatal — buffet-format multi-cuisine that leans into Garhwali specials (kafuli, phaanu, mandua roti). Open to non-residents on prior reservation. Ranked #2 of 8 in Kanatal. Hours 11am-11pm.
insider_tip: Call ahead — non-resident dining is space-permitting. Ask specifically for the Garhwali thali; the default buffet skews North Indian. The chef Anand is the one to compliment if it lands.
signature_address: 11 Km Stone, Chamba Mussoorie Road, Kanatal 249145

name: Green Terrasse
why_it_matters: Club Mahindra's specialty Garhwali outlet — separate from the main buffet hall. Listed independently on TripAdvisor with a 5.0 rating. The kitchen highlights regional ingredients (zangoora rice, til, bhang seeds) the resort buffet glosses over.
insider_tip: This is the only à-la-carte Garhwali experience inside the resort — book it the night before through the front desk, not the buffet. Ingredient substitutions happen when authentic items run out, so ask what's on the day's menu.
signature_address: Club Mahindra Kanatal Resort, 11 Km Stone, Chamba Mussoorie Road, Kanatal 249145

name: Himalayan Kiwi Restaurant
why_it_matters: In-house restaurant of Himalayan Kiwi resort, sitting amid the property's apple-and-kiwi orchard. Open to walk-ins. The menu spans traditional Uttarakhandi (kafuli, aloo gutuk) and standard hill-station Chinese-Indian — broader than most resort-only kitchens.
insider_tip: Visit in October-November when the orchard's fruit is in season — the kitchen runs fresh kiwi juice and apple desserts only during those weeks. The grounds are walkable while you wait for food.
signature_address: Himalayan Kiwi Resort, Chamba-Mussoorie Highway, Kanatal 249145

name: Aarvi's Kitchen
why_it_matters: Locally-run independent kitchen near Incredible Adventure (the campsite), opposite Club Mahindra. The cheapest hot meal in Kanatal — most reviews single out the momos. Ranked #6 of 8 on TripAdvisor.
insider_tip: It's a small one-room set-up, easy to miss from the road. Order momos and thukpa together — the broth is the leftover veg-stock from the morning's prep. Closes early in winter (by 8pm).
signature_address: Near Incredible Adventure, Chamba Mussoorie Road, Kanatal 249145

name: Camp Carnival Dining
why_it_matters: Camp-attached buffet dining about 1 km past Club Mahindra towards Dhanaulti, on the Kaudia Range side. Veg + non-veg buffets served in canvas dining tents — included in the camping package, but day-trippers can book meals via the office. Bar service with bbq in the evening.
insider_tip: Day visitors must call ahead — the kitchen plans portions per booked tent. The bonfire-bbq slot (7-9pm) is the only meal worth driving up for solo; lunch is package-quality.
signature_address: Chamba-Mussoorie Road, Near Dhanaulti, Kaudia Range, Kanatal 249145
